title: Muscle mass lost per decade (percent)

source.name: Sarcopenia with aging
source.publisher: U.S. Dept. of Health and Human Services / Office on Women's Health, citing NIH-backed research

notes: Commonly cited ranges: 3-5% muscle mass lost per decade after age 30 (midpoint 4%), accelerating to 13-24% per decade after age 70 (midpoint 18%).
